title: GEMglPixelZoom

messages.description: x zoom factor for pixel write operations
y zoom factor for pixel write operations

arguments.description: x zoom factor for pixel write operations
y zoom factor for pixel write operations

body: [GEMglPixelZoom] calls glPixelZoom() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glPixelZoom in the OpenGL reference.
